name: Leading Edge Data Centres Newcastle / Hunter facility
notes: LEDC announced its Tier III Newcastle data centre in the Steel River Industrial Estate, describing a 75-rack facility for local businesses; Data Center Map lists Leading Edge DC Newcastle near McIntosh Drive.

name: Kurri Kurri Data Centre
developer: ADW Johnson Pty Ltd / undisclosed end user
notes: The proposal is for a 540 MW AI/cloud data centre on Hart Road, Loxford at the former Hydro Aluminium Kurri Kurri smelter site in the Hunter region, about 37 km from Newcastle. Newcastle Weekly reported NSW DPHI had issued SEARs after a scoping report, with an EIS still required.

name: 5G Networks North Sydney Data Centre
notes: 5GN Wholesale lists the North Sydney Data Centre at 39 Herbert Street, St Leonards with 1.5 MW of power availability and 150-rack capacity; 5GN's 2020 ASX release announced acquisition of the North Sydney data centre.

name: Microsoft Azure Australia East - North Sydney listing
notes: Aggregator listings place a Microsoft Azure Australia East-New South Wales data centre at 1 Denison Street, North Sydney. Microsoft does not publicly disclose detailed capacity for this location in the sources found.

name: Northern Beaches Council Dee Why data centre
notes: Northern Beaches Council's awarded co-location tender states NEXTDC was contracted for two external data centres at Artarmon and North Ryde to support relocation of critical servers out of Council's Dee Why DC, confirming an existing council data centre in Dee Why.

name: Leading Edge Data Centres Orange regional edge site
notes: DCD reported LEDC planned more NSW edge facilities after its initial roll-out and was looking to build in Orange. No later project-specific approval or opening source was found during this pass, so status remains planned.

name: Leading Edge Data Centres Parkes regional edge site
notes: DCD reported LEDC was looking to build in Parkes as part of its NSW regional edge data centre expansion. No later project-specific approval or opening source was found during this pass, so status remains planned.

name: Kelpie Facility Parkes
notes: WRAP Engineering's data-centre capability statement lists 'Kelpie Facility, Parkes, NSW' among data centre/mission-critical experience, but the public document does not identify the proponent, capacity, approval status, or exact site.
